mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.5% signals accelerating economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of accelerating GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of declining industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of monetary tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 5% signals accelerating consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of accelerating retail sales.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below 1000 signals weakening construction activity, reducing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of declining housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% signals accelerating inflation, leading the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of accelerating inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the employment-population ratio (PAYEMS) above 60% signals strengthening labor market conditions, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of strengthening labor market conditions.
